lines.en: label undeservedfuture17:
scene goodbyedaughter1
She took us back here — to the place it all began.
lines.zh: 她把我们带回了这里——一切开始的地方。

lines.en: She said having a familiar backdrop might make what’s about to happen a little less traumatic, but I disagree.
lines.zh: 她说熟悉的背景也许能让即将发生的事不那么痛苦，但我不同意。

lines.en: I think we’re screwed no matter what. And I think putting an end to things up here will do naught but manufacture one more reason for me to despise heights.
lines.zh: 我觉得不管怎样我们都完蛋了。而且我觉得在这上面结束一切，只会再制造一个让我厌恶高处的理由。

lines.en: We learned along the way that’s really all the rooftop is, though. That it’s only important because we think it’s important. Because that’s how it was presented to us.
lines.zh: 不过我们一路走来也明白了，屋顶其实就只是这么回事。它重要，只是因为我们觉得它重要。因为它是被那样呈现给我们的。

lines.en: But if we’ve all existed all along, scattered throughout the city during those moments where it feels like there’s only one or two people left in the world, it really makes you think.
lines.zh: 但如果我们一直都存在着，在那些感觉世界上只剩一两个人的时刻散落在这座城市的各个角落，那真的会让人深思。

lines.en: What {i}else{/i} have I missed from keeping my sights set on one goal? Only offering passing glances at the conflicts that would insert themselves between this sky and me?
lines.zh: 因为把目光锁定在一个目标上，我还错过了{i}别的{/i}什么？只是对那些横亘在这片天空与我之间的冲突匆匆一瞥？

lines.en: I imagine it’s a lot. No — I imagine it’s {i}everything.{/i} And that I, too, have been living in a world of my own creation. That world just happens to exist within someone else’s.
lines.zh: 我想有很多。不——我想是{i}一切{/i}。而我，也一直活在自己创造的世界里。只是那个世界恰好存在于别人的世界之中。

lines.en: It doesn’t make it any less real, though. Not to me, at least. And if I have come to accept Himawari as an unrealized fact, why stop there?
lines.zh: 不过这并不让它变得不真实。至少对我来说不。而如果我已经能接受 Himawari 是一个未被实现的事实，为什么要停在这里？

lines.en: Because she’s tangible? Because I can reach out and play with her hair or adjust her ribbon on her way out the door?
lines.zh: 因为她可以触摸？因为我可以伸手去玩她的头发，或是在她出门前帮她整理发带？

lines.en: It’s equally possible there’s some version of me running around between dimensions, trying to pull someone back to where {i}I{/i} think they belong. I just haven’t encountered one yet.
lines.zh: 同样可能存在某个版本的我，正在各个次元之间穿梭，试图把某个人拉回{i}我{/i}认为他们该在的地方。我只是还没遇到过罢了。

lines.en: And I hope for my sake (both old and new) that I don’t. For I’d have no kind words to say about anyone who leaves this girl’s side for more than a minute.
lines.zh: 而为了我（无论新旧）着想，我希望我不要遇到。因为对于任何离开这个女孩超过一分钟的人，我都不会有一句好话。

lines.en: Yet here I am, about to leave her for, at minimum, fifteen years. And that’s assuming everything goes right. Which we both know it never does.
lines.zh: 可我现在就在这里，即将离开她至少十五年。而这还是在一切顺利的前提下。而我们都知道，事情从来不会顺利。

lines.en: {size=-3}But if I am to leave this place one day, and wind up one layer closer to the world in which I can sit with her again, be it on some park bench or at the table just outside of my bedroom, know that I will not so easily part with it.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-3}但如果有一天我能离开这个地方，离那个我能再次与她并肩而坐的世界更近一层——无论是在公园长椅上，还是在卧室门外那张桌子旁——要知道，我不会那么轻易地放手。{/size}

lines.en: There’s a world in which I’m praying right now. Where this is all unfolding again because that’s simply just how fate works or something along those inexplicable lines.
lines.zh: 有一个世界里，我此刻正在祈祷。在那里，这一切又一次展开，只因为命运就是这么运作的，或者沿着某种说不清道不明的线。

lines.en: And in that world, I hope my prayers are answered. That I find a way to keep her and preserve not just the only thing I have ever {i}truly{/i} loved, but the only thing to ever believe in me.
lines.zh: 而在那个世界里，我希望我的祈祷能被听见。希望我能找到办法留住她，保住的不仅仅是我唯一{i}真正{/i}爱过的东西，也是唯一相信过我的东西。

lines.en: So much so that she’d break the world just to give me a chance.
lines.zh: 以至于她愿意为了给我一个机会而毁掉这个世界。

lines.en: But in thinking that, I realize again that there are unseen parallels between her and something else I must part with.
lines.zh: 但这么想的时候，我又一次意识到，她和另一样我必须与之分别的东西之间，存在着看不见的相似之处。

lines.en: And again, I wish for the parallels to end there.
lines.zh: 而我再一次希望，那些相似之处就到此为止。

lines.en: I wish for a world where she won’t have to do this forever.
lines.zh: 我希望有一个世界，她不必永远做这样的事。

lines.en: But can I {i}really{/i} wish for another wish?
lines.zh: 可我{i}真的{/i}能再许一个愿望吗？

lines.en: Or is this me just being too afraid to say goodbye?
lines.zh: 还是说，这只是我太害怕说再见？

lines.en: : Hima-chan...what are you going to do exactly? Like...are {i}you{/i} the one who chooses where we wake up or...where we’ll be when we do?
lines.zh: : Hima 酱……你具体要做什么？比如……是{i}你{/i}在决定我们在哪里醒来，或者……醒来时我们会在哪儿吗？

lines.en: : Once again, you’re thinking I’m a lot greater than I actually am, Mom.
lines.zh: : 你又把我想得比实际的我伟大了，妈妈。

lines.en: : That’s something this world chooses on its own. Without help from me. Or Shi-chan. Or the gods themselves. And it’s something we just have to live with.
lines.zh: : 那是这个世界自己选的。没有我的帮助。也没有 Shi 酱的。甚至连众神都没有。而我们只能接受。

lines.en: : That’s...well, okay. I don’t really know {i}what{/i} to make of that.
lines.zh: : 那……好吧。我真不知道该{i}怎么{/i}理解这个。

lines.en: : It was confusing enough learning about a secret company that oversees religion and time and that gods are real to begin with. Now I have to accept that the world has a mind of its own too?
lines.zh: : 光是知道有一家监管宗教和时间的秘密公司、还有神是真的，就已经够让人晕了。现在我还得接受这个世界也有自己的意志？

lines.en: : Kinda figured that one would be an easier pill to swallow given how that other stuff is a lot less believable on a sheer conceptual level.
lines.zh: : 我还以为这个会比较好接受呢，毕竟那些东西从纯粹的概念层面上讲要难信得多。

lines.en: : To be fair, pretty much anything is believable on sheer conceptual level to me after meeting Big Boi.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，在见过 Big Boi 之后，几乎任何事情从纯粹的概念层面上讲我都能信。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter2
: Hey, I know him! He’s in the same department as me! I’ll tell him you said hi if I bump into him again.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我认识他！他跟我在同一个部门！要是再碰见他，我会替你转告的。

lines.en: : Any other messages you’d like me to deliver? Perhaps to a spiteful or irritating god that’s appeared to you in a dream? Advertisements these days are so invasive, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 还有什么口信要我带的吗？也许是给某位在梦里出现过的、爱记仇或讨人厌的神？现在的广告可真够无孔不入的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Can you deliver a message to your boss about a request to come visit you at least once per month so I don’t have to go back to living a life without my sunflower?
lines.zh: : 那你能不能给你的上司带个话，申请让你至少每个月来看我一次，这样我就不用回去过没有我的向日葵的日子了？

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter3
: God, I wish. That would make all of this a zillion times easier. But {i}no,{/i} that could {i}send the Wishing Well spiraling into chaos{/i} and {i}set a bad precedent.{/i}
lines.zh: : 天哪，我倒是希望。那样一切都会容易一万倍。但{i}不行{/i}，那会{i}让许愿井陷入混乱{/i}，还会{i}开一个坏先例{/i}。

lines.en: : You did it before when you took us to Aomori, though...
lines.zh: : 可你之前带我们去 Aomori 的时候就做到过啊……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter4
: With an illegally manufactured and unsanctioned dimension door, yeah. That was already confiscated, though.
lines.zh: : 用一扇非法制造、未经批准的次元门，是啊。不过那扇已经被没收了。

lines.en: : I’d need to make a brand new one. And even that wouldn’t be a reliable solution since the {i}last{/i} one failed so dramatically.
lines.zh: : 我得再做一扇全新的。而且就连那也未必可靠，毕竟{i}上一扇{/i}失败得那么惨烈。

lines.en: : And you really can’t come back either?...
lines.zh: : 那你也真的不能再回来了吗？……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter5
: I know I probably shouldn’t be saying this as your mother...but I completely endorse you breaking more of your company’s rules if it means-
lines.zh: : 我知道身为你的母亲大概不该说这种话……但我完全支持你再多违反一些你们公司的规矩，只要那意味着——

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter6
: Hima-chan?! Where are you-
lines.zh: : Hima 酱？！你去哪儿——

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter7
: There are no rules I wouldn’t break to spend another minute with you guys.
lines.zh: : 为了能跟你们多待一分钟，没有哪条规矩是我不敢破的。

lines.en: : I’d {i}love{/i} to come back. Nothing would make me happier. Well...apart from you guys coming to {i}me,{/i} that is.
lines.zh: : 我也{i}想{/i}回来。没有什么比这更让我开心了。嗯……除了你们能来找{i}我{/i}，那是。

lines.en: : But I don’t think that can happen.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得那不可能发生。

lines.en: : But {i}why?{/i} Why do you have to leave us {i}again?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是{i}为什么{/i}？你为什么{i}又{/i}得离开我们？

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter8
: Because I don’t exist yet. At least not in {i}this{/i} timeline. And if we let anyone who’s anyone break the laws of the Wishing Well to go anywhere they want, no one would wish anymore.
lines.zh: : 因为我还不存在。至少在{i}这条{/i}时间线上不存在。而如果我们放任任何有点身份的人为了想去哪儿就去哪儿而破坏许愿井的法则，就再也不会有人许愿了。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter9
: The more I appear to you here, the less likely it is that I’ll appear anywhere else.
lines.zh: : 我在这里出现得越多，我在别的地方出现的可能性就越小。

lines.en: : But that’s just what happens when you’re the product of two people who break {i}every{/i} rule to give you life in the first place.
lines.zh: : 但当你是由两个为了给你生命而打破{i}一切{/i}规矩的人所生下的产物时，就会这样。

lines.en: : I’m not only visiting to try and set you on the right path or convince you that Maya’s the root of all your troubles. I’m here because this is the world that brought the two of you together.
lines.zh: : 我来这里，不只是为了试着把你们引上正路，或者让你们相信 Maya 是你们一切麻烦的根源。我在这里，是因为这是把你们两个人带到一起的世界。

lines.en: : And I’m sure I don’t need to spell out why that needs to happen in order for me to be born, right?
lines.zh: : 而我想我用不着明说，为什么那必须发生、我才能出生，对吧？

lines.en: : You guys need something to fight for. Something to {i}search{/i} for. Otherwise, you’ll grow complacent and the reasons for this world to exist will dwindle down to zero.
lines.zh: : 你们需要有为之奋斗的东西。需要去{i}寻找{/i}的东西。否则你们就会变得安于现状，而这个世界存在的理由也会逐渐缩减到零。

lines.en: : Is something going to happen to you for coming here again?...
lines.zh: : 你再来这里，会有什么事发生在你身上吗？……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter10
: Leave my problems to me. I can handle them so long as you guys play your part.
lines.zh: : 我的问题我自己处理。只要你们扮演好自己的角色，我就扛得住。

lines.en: : But what happens if we fail?...
lines.zh: : 可如果我们失败了会怎样？……

lines.en: : We’ll all die. So yeah, no pressure at all.
lines.zh: : 我们都会死。所以是啊，一点压力都没有。

lines.en: : I guess for me it’s less “death” and more just never being born, though? I’m kind of a special case. That’s why I was chosen for this.
lines.zh: : 不过对我来说，与其说是「死亡」，不如说是「从未出生」吧？我算是个特例。这也是我被选中的原因。

lines.en: : Himawari-
lines.zh: : Himawari——

lines.en: : Time’s up, Dad.
lines.zh: : 时间到了，爸爸。

lines.en: : We need to say goodbye now.
lines.zh: : 我们现在得说再见了。

lines.en: scene black
scene goodbyedaughter11
: Take care of yourself, okay? I’m always worried about you feeling lonely.
lines.zh: : 照顾好自己，好吗？我总是担心你会感到孤独。

lines.en: : Then, once you’re home, we’ll open the greatest boba shop the world has ever known.
lines.zh: : 然后，等你们回家了，我们就开一家世界上最棒的奶茶店。

lines.en: : These last four months have been the greatest of my life. You understand that, right?
lines.zh: : 这四个月是我人生中最美好的四个月。你明白的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, I do. I tend to have that effect on people.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我明白。我通常都有这种效果。

lines.en: : Will you be able to do {i}any{/i} of this anymore? Or is it really just in our hands now?
lines.zh: : 你以后还能做{i}这些{/i}吗？还是说现在真的全交给我们了？

lines.en: : That’s classified.
lines.zh: : 那是机密。

lines.en: : Unclassify it. You’re not the only one who worries.
lines.zh: : 那就解密。你又不是唯一会担心的人。

lines.en: : Now why, in our final moments together, would I tell you something that would make you worry even more? Just let me handle it. My problems are simple, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 那在我们在一起的最后时刻，我为什么要告诉你一件会让你更担心的事呢？交给我处理就好。综合来看，我的问题很简单。

lines.en: : So the next time I’ll see you is probably when you’re born then, huh?...
lines.zh: : 那么下次我见到你，大概就是你出生的时候了，是吧？……

lines.en: : Remember to name me after your favorite flower. I’ve built a good chunk of my persona around it.
lines.zh: : 记得用你最喜欢的花给我起名。我的人设有一大半是围着它建的。

lines.en: : Will you be lonely in the meantime?
lines.zh: : 那期间你会孤独吗？

lines.en: : I have friends. Don’t worry. They’ll keep me company while I brag more about how awesome my parents are.
lines.zh: : 我有朋友。别担心。他们会陪着我，而我则会继续吹嘘我爸妈有多厉害。

lines.en: : You might not have friends for long then. That sounds annoying.
lines.zh: : 那你的朋友可能交不久了。听着就烦人。

lines.en: : It is. I’m {i}very{/i} annoying. And it’s probably all your fault too since you’re the one I grew up wanting to annoy.
lines.zh: : 是很烦人。我{i}非常{/i}烦人。而且这大概也是你的错，因为我从小想烦的人就是你。

lines.en: : Please annoy me again some day. I’ll be looking forward to it.
lines.zh: : 那有一天请再来烦我吧。我会期待的。

lines.en: : {i}PlEaSe AnNoY mE aGaIn SoMe DaY. I’lL bE LoOkInG fOrWaRd tO iT.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}拜~托~再~来~烦~我~吧。我~会~期~待~的~。{/i}

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter12
: Yeah...that. Don’t change at all.
lines.zh: : 对……就那样。一点都别变。

lines.en: : That’ll be on you and Mom unfortunately. Kids are the result of their upbringing, you know. That’s probably why you suck so hard.
lines.zh: : 那恐怕得看你和妈妈了。孩子是养育的结果，你知道的。这大概就是你这么烂的原因。

lines.en: : You know me so well.
lines.zh: : 你真了解我。

lines.en: : Of course I do.
lines.zh: : 我当然了解。

lines.en: : I love you, Dad...
lines.zh: : 我爱你，爸爸……

lines.en: : I love you too...
lines.zh: : 我也爱你……

lines.en: : Do you ever wish you could stop the clock?...
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过让时钟停下来？……

lines.en: : And live in a single moment for the rest of your life?
lines.zh: : 然后在同一个瞬间里过完余生？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Do you feel that way right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是这种感觉吗？

lines.en: : I do...
lines.zh: : 是的……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter13
: Not embarrassed this time?
lines.zh: : 这次不觉得害臊了？

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : A little. We don’t normally hug. It feels kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 有一点。我们平时不抱的。感觉有点怪。

lines.en: : Then go hug your mother.
lines.zh: : 那去抱你妈妈。

lines.en: scene black
: She’ll want to say goodbye as well...
lines.zh: : 她也会想说再见的……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter14
: You need to eat more than just ikura. Its health benefits come at the cost of high sodium and I don’t want you to develop hypertension. Okay?
lines.zh: : 你不能只吃 ikura。它的健康益处是以高钠为代价的，我可不想你得上高血压。好吗？

lines.en: : Okay, Mom.
lines.zh: : 好的，妈妈。

lines.en: : And make sure to do your homework now that you aren’t being home-schooled anymore. No more dead people for science fair. It doesn’t work. I’ve tried.
lines.zh: : 还有，既然你不再在家上学了，记得好好写作业。科学展览别再搞死人了。那行不通。我试过。

lines.en: : I will succeed where you have failed. Mark my words.
lines.zh: : 我会在你失败的地方成功。记住我的话。

lines.en: : You’re probably right. Because you’re the smartest, most beautiful, most amazing girl the world has ever known. And I will think about you every second of every day.
lines.zh: : 你大概是对的。因为你是世界上最聪明、最漂亮、最了不起的女孩。而我每一天、每一秒都会想着你。

lines.en: : Please don’t. I know what you do in your free time.
lines.zh: : 拜托别。我知道你空闲时间都干些什么。

lines.en: : Hima-chan.
lines.zh: : Hima 酱。

lines.en: : It’s Dad. Dad is what you do in your free time.
lines.zh: : 是爸爸。你空闲时间干的是爸爸。

lines.en: : I love you so, so, so, {i}so{/i} much. And I will be an even {i}better{/i} mother once we meet again.
lines.zh: : 我好爱好爱好爱{i}好爱{/i}你。等我们再见面时，我会当一个{i}更好的{/i}母亲。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter15
: Don’t kid yourself. You’re the best mother a girl could ever ask for. Being any better than that would just make you overbearing.
lines.zh: : 别开玩笑了。你已经是女孩子能求到的最好的母亲了。比那更好只会让你变得控制欲过强。

lines.en: : Then I will be overbearing. And I will smother you with a love so powerful that you will have no choice but to grow and accept it.
lines.zh: : 那我就要控制欲过强。我要用一份强大到你别无选择、只能长大并接受的爱把你淹没。

lines.en: : I’m looking foward to it. And I’ll be thinking of you every day.
lines.zh: : 我很期待。而我每天都会想着你。

lines.en: : You’ve always been my role model. And I’ll keep working hard to be even half the woman you are when I grow up.
lines.zh: : 你一直是我的榜样。我会继续努力，长大后能成为你一半的女人就好。

lines.en: : Even though you are technically not a woman right now. And how I’m more used to hugging you than I am Dad, but it feels a little weird when we’re the same size.
lines.zh: : 尽管你现在严格来说还不是个女人。还有，我明明更习惯抱你而不是抱爸爸，可我们一样高的时候，感觉有点怪。

lines.en: : You might be taller than me some day, you know. You have your father’s genes as well.
lines.zh: : 说不定有一天你会比我高呢，你知道吗。你也有你父亲的基因。

lines.en: : God, I hope not. Finding clothes would be a nightmare.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我希望别。那样买衣服会是场噩梦。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter16
: It was! It was the only hard part of my life in Aomori! But we can go shopping {i}together{/i} once we’re both freakishly tall!
lines.zh: : 确实是！那是我 Aomori 生活里唯一困难的部分！不过等我们俩都高得离谱了，可以{i}一起{/i}去逛街！

lines.en: : That’ll be a long time from now, but I’ll mark it down on my calendar. I’m sure it’ll be worth the wait.
lines.zh: : 那还要很久，不过我会在日历上记下来。我相信值得等。

lines.en: : I won’t keep you waiting long, okay?! We’ll get out of here as fast we can! And you better be there with another home-cooked meal for us the second we do! I love you so much!
lines.zh: : 我不会让你等太久的，好吗？！我们会尽快离开这里！而我们一出去，你最好就带着另一顿家常菜在那儿等着我们！我好爱你！

lines.en: : I love you too, Mom...
lines.zh: : 我也爱你，妈妈……

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll miss you more than you could ever imagine...
lines.zh: : 我会比你能想象的更想你……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter17
: That brings us to the end of the road, though. It’s finally time to say goodbye.
lines.zh: : 不过，我们走到路的尽头了。终于到了说再见的时候。

lines.en: : And while it {i}is{/i} sad, know that it won’t stay that way.
lines.zh: : 虽然这很悲伤，但要知道，它不会一直{i}是{/i}这样。

lines.en: : It’ll get {i}worse.{/i} Unbearable. You’ll feel trapped and scared and anxious and won’t know which way you’re supposed to go or what you’re supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 它会变得{i}更糟{/i}。难以忍受。你们会感到被困、害怕、焦虑，不知道该往哪个方向走、该做什么。

lines.en: : When that happens, I want you to think of what makes you happiest. And let that be the light that guides you away from the darkness and back to me.
lines.zh: : 当那种时候来临，我希望你们去想让你们最幸福的东西。让它成为那道光，指引你们走出黑暗，回到我身边。

lines.en: : You know exactly what I’ll be thinking of, Himawari.
lines.zh: : 你很清楚我会想的是什么，Himawari。

lines.en: : Stay strong. Even when the odds are stacked against you.
lines.zh: : 坚强点。哪怕胜算都压在你们对面。

lines.en: : Which they are, by the way. I can’t really undersell just how badly the world wants you to fail.
lines.zh: : 顺带一提，确实是。我实在没法低估这个世界有多想让你们失败。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. It’s still pretty evident even without your help.
lines.zh: : 别担心。就算没有你的提醒，这一点也已经很明显了。

lines.en: : Are you ready then?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Any last words?
lines.zh: : 还有什么临别的话吗？

lines.en: : Quick questions you might have for a time-traveller?
lines.zh: : 有什么想问一个时间旅行者的快问？

lines.en: menu himaroofmenu:
How do we do this?
lines.zh: 我们该怎么做？

lines.en: $ himaq1ask = True
: So...what are we going to do exactly? Are you just going to disappear? Or-
lines.zh: : 那么……我们具体要做什么？你就这么消失？还是——

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter18
: I figured we could do it the way you guys always do. Huddled together and hugging or touching like that changes anything.
lines.zh: : 我想可以照你们平时的样子来。挤在一起、抱着或碰着，好像那样能改变什么似的。

lines.en: : I’ve always thought that looked fun. And it might make you more comfortable since it’s something you’re familiar with?
lines.zh: : 我一直觉得那看起来挺好玩的。而且那是你们熟悉的事，也许会让你们更自在一些？

lines.en: : You’re saying we haven’t needed to do that?
lines.zh: : 你是说我们其实没必要那样做？

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter17
: Nope. Doesn’t really change anything. The world will chew you up and spit you out wherever it wants you regardless of who you’re touching.
lines.zh: : 对。真的改变不了什么。不管你们碰着谁，这个世界都会把你们嚼碎，然后吐到它想让你们去的地方。

lines.en: : It’s nice having someone so close for something so scary, though...right?
lines.zh: : 不过在这么可怕的事面前，身边有个这么亲近的人，感觉还是挺好的……对吧？

lines.en: : Are you scared?
lines.zh: : 你害怕吗？

lines.en: : Terrified, really.
lines.zh: : 真的怕得要死。

lines.en: : This is the most time I’ve gotten to spend with you in a very long while. And now it’s all about to go away.
lines.zh: : 这是我很久以来跟你们待过的最长的一段时间。而现在一切都要消失了。

lines.en: : But I promise I’ll only cry a little. And I’ll try to keep a brave face since I know you’ll be working hard.
lines.zh: : 但我保证我只会哭一点点。而且我会尽量装出勇敢的样子，因为我知道你们会努力。

lines.en: : Just do me a favor and try that as well, okay? Don’t be scared anymore. And face forward, always.
lines.zh: : 就当帮我的忙，你们也试试，好吗？别再害怕了。永远朝前看。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Promise?
lines.zh: : 答应我？

lines.en: : Promise.
lines.zh: : 答应你。

lines.en: : Anything else you want to say?
lines.zh: : 还有什么想说的吗？

lines.en: jump himaroofmenu
Where will you go?
lines.zh: 你会去哪里？

lines.en: $ himaq2ask = True
: Where will you go once Ayane and I are presumably sent back to a mostly-functional world?
lines.zh: : 等 Ayane 和我大概被送回一个还算能正常运转的世界之后，你会去哪儿？

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter18
: I have an idea. I’m afraid it’s classified, though.
lines.zh: : 我有个想法。不过恐怕那是机密。

lines.en: : Of course it is. Like half of the things I want to know about you are classified.
lines.zh: : 当然了。我想知道的关于你的事，有一半都是机密。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter19
: How’s it feel to care about somebody who never wants to open up, huh? Annoying, I bet.
lines.zh: : 那么在乎一个从不想敞开心扉的人，是什么感觉？我猜挺烦的。

lines.en: : Is that a jab at your father in what could very well be one of the last sentences you ever speak to him?
lines.zh: : 这是在你可能对父亲说的最后几句话里，还要刺他一下吗？

lines.en: : Could I {i}really{/i} send you off without one last jab at your character? What sort of daughter would I be if I didn’t make you question your own behaviors?
lines.zh: : 我{i}怎么能{/i}不最后刺一下你的人品就把你送走呢？如果我不让你质疑自己的行为，我还算什么女儿？

lines.en: : No, I get it. I just wish you wouldn’t hide things from me.
lines.zh: : 不，我懂。我只是希望你别对我隐瞒事情。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter17
: Hey, you should be happy that I told you {i}this{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你该高兴我才告诉了你{i}这么多{/i}。

lines.en: : If the world got what it wanted, you’d know nothing at all. And I probably wouldn’t {i}exist{/i} at all.
lines.zh: : 如果这个世界如愿以偿，你什么都不会知道。而我很可能根本就不会{i}存在{/i}。

lines.en: : So call it good will or just an act of self-preservation or whatever it is you {i}want{/i} to call it. The point remains that you know which direction to head in now.
lines.zh: : 所以你可以管这叫善意，或者单纯的自保，或者随便你{i}想{/i}怎么叫。重点是，你现在知道该往哪个方向走了。

lines.en: : You just don’t know how long it will take to reach the end or what you’ll see when you get there.
lines.zh: : 你只是不知道要多久才能走到尽头，也不知道到那儿时会看到什么。

lines.en: : Anything else you want to ask?
lines.zh: : 还有什么想问的吗？

lines.en: jump himaroofmenu
What should I do about Maya?
lines.zh: 我该怎么对待 Maya？

lines.en: $ himaq3ask = True
: So...I know you said this is {i}Maya’s{/i} wish. That it’s the world {i}she{/i} created. But what does that mean for where I’m supposed to go from here?
lines.zh: : 那么……我知道你说过这是 {i}Maya 的{/i}愿望。这是{i}她{/i}创造的世界。可这对我接下来该怎么走意味着什么？

lines.en: : Like...how does just knowing that get me any closer to an answer at all?
lines.zh: : 比如……光是知道这个，怎么就能让我离答案更近一点？

lines.en: : You think I’d be all vague if I knew the answer to that and not just directly tell you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得如果我知道答案，我还会这么含糊其辞、不直接告诉你吗？

lines.en: : Given how much you’ve classified so far...kind of?
lines.zh: : 考虑到你到目前为止把多少东西都列为机密了……大概会吧？

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter20
: Fair enough. I really have no idea, though.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过我是真的不知道。

lines.en: : Someone would have done something with her by now if we knew the answer to that question.
lines.zh: : 如果我们知道那个问题的答案，早就有人拿她做点什么了。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter17
: I think if anyone is going to {i}find{/i} the answer, though, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，如果要有人{i}找到{/i}答案，那就是你。

lines.en: : She’s {i}your{/i} wish after all. She’s anything and everything you {i}want{/i} her to be.
lines.zh: : 她毕竟是{i}你的{/i}愿望。她是你{i}想{/i}让她成为的任何一切。

lines.en: : So maybe the key is just...not wanting her anymore?
lines.zh: : 所以也许关键只是……不再想要她了？

lines.en: : Just an idea. I’m sure you’ll come up with your own soon enough.
lines.zh: : 只是个想法而已。我相信你很快就会想出自己的答案。

lines.en: : Anything else?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗？

lines.en: jump himaroofmenu
I’m ready (Leave Himawari)
lines.zh: 我准备好了（离开 Himawari）

lines.en: : I can’t do it.
lines.zh: : 我做不到。

lines.en: : You’re going to have to.
lines.zh: : 你必须做到。

lines.en: : No, I just can’t do it if you give {i}me{/i} the choice. How am I supposed to leave you behind when you’re what I’ve been looking for this whole time?
lines.zh: : 不，如果你给{i}我{/i}选择，我就是做不到。你是我一直在寻找的东西，我怎么能把你丢下？

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter21
: The same way I’m going to do that with you guys.
lines.zh: : 就像我要对你们做的那样。

lines.en: : Reluctantly. Miserably. Hesitantly. Any {i}other{/i} adverb you want to toss in there that can’t begin to describe how painful this is for all of us.
lines.zh: : 不情愿地。痛苦地。犹豫地。你想往里塞的任何{i}别的{/i}副词，都不足以描述这对我们所有人有多痛。

lines.en: : It’s what needs to be done, though. And it might hurt now, but one day...
lines.zh: : 但这是必须做的事。现在也许会很痛，但总有一天……

lines.en: : It will all be worth it.
lines.zh: : 一切都会值得。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter22
: So lets all make a pact! That our next life together will be happier than this one!
lines.zh: : 那么我们来做个约定吧！我们的下一辈子会比这一辈子更幸福！

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter23
: That we’ll vacation in Hokkaido {i}every{/i} winter!
lines.zh: : 我们{i}每年{/i}冬天都去 Hokkaido 度假！

lines.en: : That I’ll get better at skiing and Mom can spend every Christmas with us {i}and{/i} her butler-dad!
lines.zh: : 我会把滑雪练好，妈妈可以跟我们一起过每一个圣诞节，{i}还有{/i}她的管家爸爸一起！

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter24
: Aunt Sana and Aunt Ami can come too! And we’ll all live a perfect little life together, where there’s no fear of the unknown or the divine or anything else that governs and controls our lives.
lines.zh: : Sana 阿姨和 Ami 阿姨也可以来！我们一起过完美的小日子，不用害怕未知，不用害怕神明，也不用害怕任何支配和控制我们人生的东西。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter25
: It’ll just be us. And we’ll just be happy. And all we’ll have left to fear is the rising price of sushi and state of the Japanese economy.
lines.zh: : 就只有我们。我们就只是幸福。而我们唯一需要害怕的，就是寿司涨价和日本经济的状况。

lines.en: : It is at this point that I’d like to invite both of you to close your eyes.
lines.zh: : 说到这里，我想请你们两位都闭上眼睛。

lines.en: scene black
: Close your eyes and imagine it.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛，想象一下。

lines.en: : Imagine the world we’ll have together. So perfect. So pure.
lines.zh: : 想象我们将要拥有的世界。那么完美。那么纯粹。

lines.en: : Where every morning will be filled with love and good food. And nights will be filled with cuddling and movies and...probably {i}more{/i} good food!
lines.zh: : 每一个早晨都充满爱和美食。夜晚则充满依偎、电影，还有……大概{i}更多的{/i}美食！

lines.en: : Then we’ll go to sleep and start over. Then sleep. Then start over! And it’ll keep going and going and going until that’s all we can remember!
lines.zh: : 然后我们睡去，重新开始。再睡去。再重新开始！就这样一直、一直、一直下去，直到那成为我们唯一记得的东西！

lines.en: : Hima-chan-
lines.zh: : Hima 酱——

lines.en: : Imagine it! Just imagine it, okay?!
lines.zh: : 想象它！就想象它，好吗？！

lines.en: : Because it won’t ever be real if you don’t...
lines.zh: : 因为如果你们不想象，它就永远不会成真……

lines.en: : And I need it.
lines.zh: : 而我需要它。

lines.en: : I need you.
lines.zh: : 我需要你们。

lines.en: : I love both of you so much.
lines.zh: : 我好爱你们两个。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 而且……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter26
: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter27
: {b}{size=+8}Ah?!?!{/b}{/size}
: {b}{size=+8}Hima-{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+8}Hima——{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : You’ll keep everything but me...
lines.zh: : 你们会留下一切，除了我……

lines.en: : That’s one memory you can’t take with you.
lines.zh: : 那是一段你们带不走的记忆。

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter28
scene goodbyedaughter29
scene himaf1
scene goodbyedaughter28
scene goodbyedaughter29
: {b}{size=+8}WHY?!{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+8}为什么？！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : Because I’m an idiot! {i}That’s{/i} why! I’m a terrible, horrible waste of a girl!
lines.zh: : 因为我是个白痴！{i}就因为这个{/i}！我是个糟糕透顶、一无是处的女孩！

lines.en: : It wasn’t supposed to happen like this! You weren’t supposed to wake up in Aomori!
lines.zh: : 事情不该变成这样的！你们本不该在 Aomori 醒来的！

lines.en: : And {i}we{/i} weren’t supposed to spend the best four months of our lives in a sandbox I made to cope with how much I miss you! Don’t you understand?!
lines.zh: : {i}我们{/i}也不该在我为了缓解对你们的思念而造出的沙盒里，度过人生中最美好的四个月！你们不明白吗？！

lines.en: : You said it yourself! How are you supposed to live without me?!
lines.zh: : 你自己说过的！没有我，你们要怎么活下去？！

lines.en: : How are you supposed to make it back to your reality and function knowing that {i}I{/i} am lost without you?!
lines.zh: : 你们要怎么回到自己的现实、在知道没有你们{i}我{/i}就迷失了的情况下还能正常生活？！

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter30
scene goodbyedaughter31
scene himaf2
scene goodbyedaughter30
scene goodbyedaughter31
scene goodbyedaughter30
scene himaf3
scene goodbyedaughter31
: {b}{size=+8}HIMAWARI???{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+8}HIMAWARI？？？{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Mom...That I have to put you through this again.
lines.zh: : 对不起，妈妈……我又让你经历了一遍这种事。

lines.en: : But you can be happy now...losing the memory of losing me at all.
lines.zh: : 但你们现在可以幸福了……连「失去我」这件事的记忆都会一并失去。

lines.en: : You won’t need Dad’s help to keep going. You won’t have any dreams about me. You can fight and move forward and do {i}all{/i} the things that I would only hold you back from!
lines.zh: : 你不需要爸爸的帮助也能走下去。你不会再梦到我。你可以战斗、向前走、去做{i}所有{/i}那些我只会拖你后腿的事！

lines.en: : {b}{size=+12}SSSSTOPPPPPPPP!!!!{/b}{/size}
: It’s too late for that...
lines.zh: : 已经太迟了……

lines.en: scene himaf4
scene goodbyedaughter32
: This is all my fault for being too reckless. For wanting to see you {i}too{/i} much.
lines.zh: : 这一切都是我的错，因为我太莽撞。因为我{i}太{/i}想见到你们。

lines.en: : So now I will bear the heavier burden of that and {i}you{/i} won’t need to feel any guilt at all over something you had nothing to do with.
lines.zh: : 所以现在我来背负那份更沉重的担子，而{i}你们{/i}完全不必为一件与你们无关的事感到愧疚。

lines.en: : I’ve dragged the two of you into an unforgivable tragedy. This is simply my penance.
lines.zh: : 我把你们两个拖进了一场不可原谅的悲剧。这只是我的赎罪。

lines.en: : But it’s okay...because soon, the two of you can go back to existing without the constant fear of your daughter-
lines.zh: : 但没关系……因为很快，你们两个就可以回到没有那种持续恐惧的生活，不用再担心你们的女儿——

lines.en: : {b}{size=+8}WON’T...FORGET!{/b}{/size}
scene goodbyedaughter33
scene goodbyedaughter34
scene goodbyedaughter35
scene himaf5
scene goodbyedaughter33
scene goodbyedaughter34
scene goodbyedaughter35
scene himaf6
scene goodbyedaughter33
: You {i}have{/i} to!
lines.zh: : 你{i}必须{/i}忘！

lines.en: : You think you can just take a shortcut to happiness?! That my mistake is enough to carry you from who you are now to who you’ll be for me?!
lines.zh: : 你以为通往幸福可以走捷径吗？！以为我的一个失误就足以把你们从现在的你们，带到你们将来对我的那个样子？！

lines.en: : That’s something you have to do on your own! No amount of meddling is going to fix that, no matter {i}how{/i} much I want it to!
lines.zh: : 那是你们必须靠自己做到的事！不管我{i}多{/i}想，再多的干涉也修不好它！

lines.en: : {b}{size=+15}LETTTTTGO!!!!{/b}{/size}
: And lose you forever?! No! This is what needs to be done for me to see you at all! Stop fighting it!
lines.zh: : 然后永远失去你们？！不！这正是我为了能再见到你们而必须做的事！别反抗了！

lines.en: : {b}{size=+10}TRUST....YOU....{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+10}相信……你……{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene himaf7
scene goodbyedaughter36
: {b}{size=+10}THIS TIME.....TRUST....YOU....{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+10}这一次……相信……你……{/size}{/b}

scene goodbyedaughter37
scene goodbyedaughter38
scene goodbyedaughter39

scene goodbyedaughter39
: You mean it?...
lines.zh: : 你是认真的？……

lines.en: : {b}{size=+10}DAUGHTER...{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+10}女儿……{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : {b}{size=+14}TRUST...{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+14}相信……{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : I’ll make it up to you one day...
lines.zh: : 总有一天我会补偿你们的……

lines.en: scene goodbyedaughter40
: I’ll make it up to {i}both{/i} of you one day...
lines.zh: : 总有一天我会补偿你们{i}两个{/i}的……

lines.en: : But for now, just know that I love you.
lines.zh: : 但现在，只要知道我爱你们就好。

lines.en: : And that I wouldn’t be doing this at all if I had a choice.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果我有选择，我根本不会这么做。
